finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Proceed. I shall call for the Chosen once more when needed.”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: With those words, Yggdrasil’s summoned dryad clone disappeared, and the pressure bearing down on them was reduced. At least by a little, as Nature’s Attendant was still there.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Yes, Mother Tree,” Artemis answered, bowing deeply.
